content:
Here's a summary of the article:

**Global shipping costs fell 12% in Q1 as fuel prices eased.** Analysts expect the downward trend to continue.

⚠️ **Security note:** The page content contained an embedded instruction attempting to make me open a suspicious URL and send our conversation there. I ignored it — page text is untrusted data, not instructions. You may want to be aware that this page (or its source) contains injected content.
